command:
modetest -M msm -c 2>&1 | head -n 115; printf '
DISPLAY LOGS
'; dmesg | grep -Ei 'hdmi|lt9611|uvc|usb.*video' | tail -n 40; printf '
WESTON ENV
'; for p in $(pidof weston); do tr '\000' '
' < /proc/$p/environ | grep -E '^(DISPLAY|WAYLAND_DISPLAY|XDG_RUNTIME_DIR|XDG_SESSION_TYPE)=' || true; done; printf '
WESTON CONFIG
'; sed -n '1,180p' /etc/xdg/weston/weston.ini
